text_block_list.text:
Walking through the park one day, I
spot
someone climbing over the barriers
fencing the
pond. Is that who I think it
is?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's all over... I should just chuck myself
in and let
the waters claim me...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Тренер?! Don't try to stop me! I'm no
better than
the algae at the bottom of
this pond, so I might
as well join it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I should let the current whisk me away,
have the
fish nibble at my body, and
wait for the swans to
pull me out and
resuscitate me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: It's... It's... Well, look at this.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She shows me a news article about the
Kinko Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Матиканэфукукитару was almost
unbearable to
watch."
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
"Her results aren't the issue—it's simply
that the
miniscule amount of effort she
puts in on the
track makes it
uncomfortable to look at her."
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
"She doesn't take any pride in herself as
an
athlete or show any sense of the
showmanship her
fans desire."
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: "As a racing fan, I find it difficult to even"... Sniffle... "call her an Umamusume. She's more like a"... Sob...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Urk! You didn't have to read the last
part!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But... they're right. It's all true. Every
word hurts
so much to hear, I wish my
ears would just fall
off...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I had it all wrong. I thought all I needed
was luck
on my side—that everyone
would be okay with
it...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But I should have known it wasn't okay.
Now I've
gone too far and even said
horrible things to
Suzuka...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, I don't even know how
to begin
apologizing to all my fans...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: You still have the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait... you're right. Spring has
only begun.
I could turn things around at
the Takarazuka
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But... No, it's no good. It won't work,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We're forgetting one crucial point. The
fans
decide who runs at the Takarazuka
Kinen—not us!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
After all I've done, who would bother
throwing my
name in the hat? I've
already gone and betrayed
them.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for trying to make me feel
better. I
know I've disappointed you too.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's probably too late, but I'll try to find
some way
to make it up to you...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll just feed the fish in the
pond and
head back.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару begins to throw bits
of bread
into the pond, and the koi
happily gobble it up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
